lines.en: label beachwars1:
scene buswarride1
At last, the time has come for yet another combination of events that should exist as their own individual entities, but have been lumped together because my class is predictably unpredictable.
lines.zh: 终于,又到了这样的时候——又一组本该各自独立存在、却因为我的班级一如既往地不可预测而被硬塞到一起的事件。

lines.en: The matter of whether or not this will measure up to last year’s “Halloween Wars” is yet to be determined-
lines.zh: 至于它能不能比得上去年的『万圣节大战』,还有待观察-

lines.en: But I am attempting to remain optimistic as swimsuits are right up there with Halloween costumes in my mental tier list of “Things I want girls to wear when they are communicating with me.”
lines.zh: 不过我正努力保持乐观,毕竟在我的心理排行『我希望女生跟我说话时穿的东西』里,泳装可是紧追万圣节服装之后的。

lines.en: But...
lines.zh: 可是……

lines.en: We {i}just{/i} did this.
lines.zh: 我们明明{i}刚{/i}干过这事。

lines.en: Albeit with a bit more tinsel, but still.
lines.zh: 虽然多了点金属丝彩带,但总之。

lines.en: I remember it...Ayane and Maya remember it...and everyone else likely remembers it to some extent too — but it is only a handful of us who understand {i}why.{/i}
lines.zh: 我记得……Ayane 和 Maya 记得……其他人大概也都多少记得——只是我们中只有少数几个明白{i}为什么{/i}。

lines.en: If recent events are indicative of what’s to come, I’m sure Makoto may join the fray as well. But that doesn’t change the looming worry I have that things are beginning to spiral out of control.
lines.zh: 如果最近的事能说明什么的话,我猜 Makoto 大概也会加入战局。但这并没有消除我那种事情正在开始失控的隐隐担忧。

lines.en: With the pace things are moving, who’s to say that several more loops from now, we won't be going on a beach trip every other weekend?
lines.zh: 照这个速度下去,谁敢说再循环几次之后,我们不会每隔一个周末就去一趟海滩?

lines.en: And sure, that might not sound horrible to you, but I’d like to remind you at this point in time that things like swimsuits and costumes are only impactful because of how rarely they’re used.
lines.zh: 当然,你听着可能觉得不错,但此时此刻我要提醒你,泳装和奇装异服之所以有冲击力,正是因为它们难得一见。

lines.en: I don’t want that to sour.
lines.zh: 我不想让那种感觉变味。

lines.en: I don’t want life to become even more complicated than it already is.
lines.zh: 我不想让生活变得比现在更复杂。

lines.en: And every time I find myself in situations like this one, that’s exactly what happens.
lines.zh: 而每当我发现自己身处这种境地,事情就偏偏会变成那样。

lines.en: For the next two days, I will be the center of attention and the object of everyone’s affection.
lines.zh: 接下来的两天里,我会成为众人注目的中心、所有人爱意的对象。

lines.en: They will dedicate themselves to me in a manner greater than what has become the standard.
lines.zh: 她们会比平常更加彻底地把自己奉献给我。

lines.en: And all the while, I will sink further into the sand knowing that there is no way this can continue without fully enveloping me and crushing my lungs.
lines.zh: 而在此期间,我会在沙子里越陷越深,心里清楚这样下去不可能不把我整个吞没、压碎我的肺。

lines.en: Sometimes, it feels like I can not breathe.
lines.zh: 有时候,我觉得自己喘不过气来。

lines.en: Sometimes, that reminds me of you.
lines.zh: 有时候,那让我想起了你。

lines.en: : So, how’s it feel knowing you only have an hour or two of freedom remaining before you become the carrot on the end of the metaphorical stick that is statutory rape?
lines.zh: : 那么,知道自己只剩一两个小时的自由、就要变成那根隐喻棍子末端吊着的胡萝卜——也就是法定强奸——之后,感觉如何?

lines.en: : Metaphors lose their impact once you start pointing out what they stand for, Imani. Also, if I’m the carrot in this particular scenario, it absolves me of statutory {i}anything.{/i}
lines.zh: : 一旦你把隐喻指代的东西点破,隐喻就失去冲击力了,Imani。而且,在这个情境里如果我是那根胡萝卜,那{i}什么{/i}『法定』都跟我无关了。

lines.en: : Yeah, well we’ll see what the judge has to say about that. Either way, must be pretty exciting being the prize for...what- the {i}third{/i} year in a row?
lines.zh: : 是啊,不过看法官怎么说吧。总之,能连续……第几年了?{i}第三{/i}年当奖品,一定很激动人心吧?

lines.en: : Yup. Which makes things very complicated when you realize they’re all first years-
lines.zh: : 嗯。而当你意识到她们全是一年级生的时候,事情就变得非常复杂了-

lines.en: scene buswarride2
: Hah...You’d think being the young and pretty student-teacher would mean that maybe {i}I’d{/i} get to be the prize instead this year.
lines.zh: : 哈……我还以为年轻又漂亮的实习老师,今年怎么说也该轮到{i}我{/i}当奖品了呢。

lines.en: : But alas, it seems that the Internet was wrong about all teens nowadays being bisexual.
lines.zh: : 唉,可惜互联网上说的『如今所有青少年都是双性恋』看来是错的。

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s something you need to worry about since at least half of our class seems to hold that preference. Also, which one of us sounds like a predator {i}now?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我觉得你不用担心这个,毕竟我们班至少有一半人是那个取向。还有,{i}现在{/i}听起来像捕食者的是我们俩中的哪一个?

lines.en: scene buswarride3
: Hey. Watch it, buddy. Wanting girls to acknowledge your youth and bangability is way different than actually utilizing said bangability. Aristotle said that.
lines.zh: : 嘿。说话注意点,老兄。希望女生认可你的年轻和好上的程度,跟真的去利用那份『好上』,可是完全不同的两码事。亚里士多德说的。

lines.en: : No he didn’t.
lines.zh: : 他没说过。

lines.en: : True. But he probably would have if he ever found himself on a bus full of jailbait.
lines.zh: : 确实。不过要是他曾经身处一辆坐满未成年尤物的巴士上,他大概会说。

lines.en: : I don’t think you’re allowed to call them that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你没资格那么叫她们。

lines.en: : Yeah, that felt kind of gross coming out of my mouth. Be a bro and don’t tell HR, please. They’ve been on my case pretty hard lately and I want them to go away.
lines.zh: : 是啊,这话从我嘴里说出来是有点恶心。帮我个忙别跟人事部说,拜托。他们最近盯我盯得特别紧,我想让他们消停点。

lines.en: : What? Why are they on {i}your{/i} case?
lines.zh: : 什么?他们为什么盯{i}你{/i}?

lines.en: scene buswarride2
: Beats me. Maybe it’s all the melanin?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。也许是因为我黑色素太多了?

lines.en: : Imani-
lines.zh: : Imani-

lines.en: scene buswarride4
: They didn’t think it was “appropriate” for a fledgling teacher like me to propose rooming with my male superior. Something about giving people the wrong idea or whatever.
lines.zh: : 他们觉得,像我这样的新老师提议跟我的男上司同住一间房不太『合适』。说什么会让人误会之类的。

lines.en: : Not like we had any other options, though. All the other rooms are booked and we’ve got twenty students to worry about. If you’re gonna get all handsy in the middle of the night, at least {i}I{/i} can fight you off.
lines.zh: : 可我们也没别的选择啊。别的房间都订满了,我们还有二十个学生要操心。要是你半夜想动手动脚,{i}我{/i}起码还能把你打退。

lines.en: : But {i}would{/i} you fight me off?
lines.zh: : 可你{i}真会{/i}打退我吗?

lines.en: scene buswarride5
: That depends almost entirely on how much I’ve had to drink and the current lunar phase. I’m at my thirstiest during full moons, just FYI.
lines.zh: : 那几乎完全取决于我喝了多少,以及当前的月相。顺便一提,满月的时候我最饥渴。

lines.en: : Are you a werewolf now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是狼人了吗?

lines.en: : Would it turn you on if I said yes?
lines.zh: : 如果我说『是』,你会不会兴奋?

lines.en: : No, but it would make me question what constitutes bestiality — which is not a thing I’ve ever really had to question before.
lines.zh: : 不会,但那会让我开始思考什么才算兽交——这可是我以前从来没需要思考过的问题。

lines.en: : Also, are you sure about this? You and me sleeping in the same room? Won’t that just lead to...complications again?
lines.zh: : 还有,你确定吗?你和我睡同一间房?那不会又……闹出麻烦吗?

lines.en: scene buswarride6
: Like I said, we don’t have any other options and it’s not like I can let you crash with the girls. I’m cool if you’re cool. But on the off-chance you’re not...again, don’t go to HR.
lines.zh: : 我说了,我们没别的选择,而且我也不能让你去跟女生们挤。你没问题我就没问题。不过万一你还是有意见……再说一遍,别去找人事部。

lines.en: : I won’t. And it’s not just because today was the first time I’ve ever heard of them being a department that actually exists in our school.
lines.zh: : 我不会。而且不只是因为今天是我第一次听说我们学校居然真有这么个部门。

lines.en: scene buswarride7
: Man, how come everybody just leaves you alone? If anyone should be making weekly check-ins with them, it’s you.
lines.zh: : 天哪,怎么大家都放着你不管?要说该每周去找他们报到的人,那也是你啊。

lines.en: : Please stop blaming me for how loved I am by everyone and everything. I can’t help it.
lines.zh: : 别再怪我被所有人和所有东西爱戴了。我也没办法。

lines.en: scene buswarride8
: Would it kill you to be a little more humble at least? Because that shit might fly with me, but we both know Wakana’s gonna be chewing your ass out all weekend for saying things like that.
lines.zh: : 你至少谦虚一点会死吗?因为这话在我这儿行得通,可我们俩都知道,Wakana 会因为你这种话念叨你一整个周末。

lines.en: : Wakana? She’s coming too?
lines.zh: : Wakana?她也来?

lines.en: scene buswarride9
: Man, do you pay {i}any{/i} attention to {i}anything?{/i} She’s coming along to announce the winner of her poetry contest. Which, by the way, she’s super pissed at you for not entering.
lines.zh: : 天哪,你到底有没有注意过{i}任何事{/i}?她会一起来宣布她那个诗歌比赛的获奖者。顺便说一句,你没投稿,她可气坏了。

lines.en: : I don’t write anymore. Also, why not just stay with her instead of me if she’s going to be there?
lines.zh: : 我早就不写了。还有,既然她也在,你为什么不干脆跟她住,而是跟我?

lines.en: : Uhhhh, because all {i}three{/i} of us are staying together? Duh. We’ve got the cool teacher room where she and I are going to sleep in the same bed and you’re going to sleep in the closet.
lines.zh: : 呃……因为我们{i}三个{/i}住一起啊?废话。我们拿到的是『酷老师房』,她和我会睡同一张床,而你睡壁橱。

lines.en: : That revelation was really enticing until the very last part of it. But hey, at least I’ll still get to hear her and Osako going at it while you’re forced to join me in the closet.
lines.zh: : 这个消息本来挺诱人的,直到最后那句。不过嘿,起码我还能听到她和 Osako 大战的声音,而你会被迫跟我一起挤壁橱。

lines.en: scene buswarride10
: Osako’s not coming. She’s got a thing.
lines.zh: : Osako 不来。她有事。

lines.en: : A thing?
lines.zh: : 有事?

lines.en: : Yeah, a thing. If I knew what it was, I would have said it. Just man up and accept that you’ll have to keep your hands off of {i}two{/i} women tonight instead of just one.
lines.zh: : 对,有事。我要是知道是什么事,我早就说了。你就爷们一点,接受今晚得对{i}两个{/i}女人管住手、而不是一个吧。

lines.en: : And also that Wakana is probably going to try and kill you and I won’t be able to stop her.
lines.zh: : 还有,Wakana 大概会想杀了你,而我也拦不住她。

lines.en: : I can handle Wakana. I’m not worried about her.
lines.zh: : 我应付得了 Wakana。我不担心她。

lines.en: : You should probably be a little worried about her. She has a whip. I’ve seen it.
lines.zh: : 你大概还是该担心她一下。她有根鞭子。我见过。

lines.en: : {i}Why{/i} have you seen it?
lines.zh: : 你{i}为什么{/i}会见过?

lines.en: scene buswarride11
: Would you believe me if I said it was because I was a bad girl?
lines.zh: : 如果我说是因为我是个坏女孩,你会信吗?

lines.en: : Yes. Right before asking you to explain in vivid detail how and why.
lines.zh: : 会。然后马上请你生动详细地解释一下经过和原因。

lines.en: : Well, I’m sorry to disappoint you but that’s not what happened. She just left it in her office and I happened to stumble across it after picking the lock to let myself in one day.
lines.zh: : 唉,很遗憾让你失望了,事情不是那样的。她只是把鞭子落在办公室里,而我有一天撬锁溜进去的时候碰巧撞见了。

lines.en: : Just lie to me next time, Imani.
lines.zh: : 下次直接骗我就行,Imani。

lines.en: : Why? So you can get a boner on the bus? That’s weird. Why would I want to give you a boner on the bus?
lines.zh: : 为什么?好让你在巴士上勃起?那也太怪了。我为什么要让你在巴士上勃起?

lines.en: : Because I’m your superior and if I want to have a boner on the bus, I can have a boner on the bus.
lines.zh: : 因为我是你的上司,我想在巴士上勃起,就能在巴士上勃起。

lines.en: : This is an abuse of power, Senpai.
lines.zh: : 这是滥用职权,前辈。

lines.en: scene black
: Your face is an abuse of power.
lines.zh: : 你这张脸才是滥用职权。

lines.en: : Ah! Who heard that?! Sensei just made a joke that wasn’t “Hot boy summer!” He’s becoming a real boy!
lines.zh: : 啊!谁听到了?!Sensei 刚讲了个不是『热辣男孩之夏』的笑话!他变成真正的男孩了!

lines.en: : Just shut up and ride the bus, Imani.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴好好坐车,Imani。

lines.en: scene buswarride12
: What are you playing, Sana? It seems a little...different from what you normally like.
lines.zh: : 你在玩什么,Sana?看起来跟你平时喜欢的……有点不一样。

lines.en: : It’s...um...it’s...a first-person shooter called...DOOM Eternal...
lines.zh: : 是……嗯……是……一款第一人称射击游戏,叫……DOOM Eternal……

lines.en: scene buswarride13
: DOOM? But you’re the cute Animal Crossing girl. You like trees and fish and stuff. What are you doing playing something that graphic?
lines.zh: : DOOM?可你是可爱的动物森友会女孩啊。你喜欢树啊鱼啊什么的。怎么会玩这么血腥的东西?

lines.en: : The cyclops has entered her dark phase. Everything we know about her is to be cast aside so the true Sana Sakakibara can rise and Zagull Throat Spear’s ultimate form can be unleashed.
lines.zh: : 独眼巨人进入她的黑暗期了。我们对她的一切认知都要被抛到一边,好让真正的 Sana Sakakibara 觉醒,让 Zagull Throat Spear 的终极形态得以释放。

lines.en: : Rin...got me into games like this...a while ago and...they’re really.............................
lines.zh: : Rin……很久以前就带我玩这类游戏了……而且它们真的…………………………

lines.en: scene buswarride14
: Hah...
: Apologies, Arborea. It appears that the cyclops has simply been hexed and that there is no final form looming on the horizon.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,Arborea。看来独眼巨人只是中了咒,并没有什么最终形态潜伏在地平线上。

lines.en: : But given Zagull’s disposition, it is probably safe to assume that Sana has always been at least mildly interested in-
lines.zh: : 不过考虑到 Zagull 的秉性,大概可以安全地假设 Sana 一直都至少是有点兴趣-

lines.en: scene buswarride15
: Ahh!
: You died, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你死了,对吧?

lines.en: scene buswarride16
: I’m still not...very good at...fast-paced games like this...
lines.zh: : 我还……不太擅长……这类快节奏的游戏……

lines.en: : It’s hard to...um...improve after...not growing up with them...
lines.zh: : 而且……从小没玩过的话……很难……提高……

lines.en: scene buswarride17
: But...um...it’s not like I...don’t like things like this...I...
lines.zh: : 不过……嗯……我也不是……不喜欢这种东西……我……

lines.en: : Horror movies...are...
lines.zh: : 恐怖片……是……

lines.en: : Oh, right...you and Ayane watch stuff like that sometimes, don’t you? I totally forgot.
lines.zh: : 哦,对……你和 Ayane 有时会看那类东西,对吧?我完全忘了。

lines.en: scene buswarride18
: R...Right...I’ve always...loved horror...but...since games are so...um...{i}active,{/i} it’s...a little...
lines.zh: : 是……是啊……我一直都……喜欢恐怖……不过……因为游戏太……嗯……{i}需要主动操作{/i},所以有点……

lines.en: scene buswarride19
: Wait...why aren’t you...with Ayane right now?...
lines.zh: : 等等……你现在为什么……没跟 Ayane 在一起?……

lines.en: : Don’t...you two normally...
lines.zh: : 你们两个不是平时都……

lines.en: scene buswarride20
: I’d just rather sit here for now if that’s okay. I don’t...think Ayane wants to talk to me at the moment.
lines.zh: : 我只是想现在先坐这儿,可以的话。我觉得……Ayane 现在不太想跟我说话。

lines.en: : Uh-oh. Sounds like a subplot.
lines.zh: : 呃哦。听起来像条支线剧情。

lines.en: : The main heroine and her best friend, hopelessly in love with the same man...must overcome adversity to rekindle their friendship and grow closer than ever be-
lines.zh: : 女主角和她最好的朋友,无可救药地爱上了同一个男人……必须克服逆境、重修旧好,变得比以往任何时候都更亲-

lines.en: : Not right now, Molly...
lines.zh: : 现在别说这个,Molly……

lines.en: scene buswarride21
: Sorry...just...trying to lighten the mood. We don’t mind if you sit here at all.
lines.zh: : 抱歉……只是……想缓和一下气氛。你坐这儿我们一点都不介意。

lines.en: : And...umm...if it makes you...feel any better...I haven’t heard...Ayane say anything that...
lines.zh: : 而且……嗯……如果说出来能让你……好受一点的话……我没听 Ayane 说过任何那样的话……

lines.en: : Just tell me more about your game, Sana. I don’t want to talk about any of that sad stuff right now.
lines.zh: : 那你就多跟我说说你的游戏吧,Sana。我现在不想聊那些难过的事。

lines.en: scene black
: Well, umm...you see this...alien thing?
lines.zh: : 那个,嗯……你看到这个……外星人了吗?

lines.en: : That’s...actually...
lines.zh: : 那其实……

lines.en: scene buswarride22
: ...and {i}that’s{/i} why I love otters. They’re like little sea puppies if puppies could hold hands and, like...you know. Live in the sea.
lines.zh: : ……{i}所以{/i}我爱水獭。它们就像小海狗,如果狗会牵手,而且……你知道的。住在海里的话。

lines.en: : Well, that was certainly the most {i}Karin{/i} conversation I’ve ever had before.
lines.zh: : 这绝对是我经历过的最 {i}Karin{/i} 的一段对话了。

lines.en: scene buswarride23
: Huh? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 嗯?你什么意思?

lines.en: : Oh, nothing bad! Just that talking to you is kind of, like...like...hugging a grandma or something.
lines.zh: : 哦,不是坏话!只是跟你说话有点像……像……抱住一位奶奶之类的。

lines.en: : A grandma?
lines.zh: : 奶奶?

lines.en: : Since you’re so wholesome. It’s like...like you’ve somehow managed to make it this far into life without ever acknowledging the crappier parts of it.
lines.zh: : 因为你太纯良了。就像……就像你不知怎么地一路活到现在,却从来没有正视过生活里那些糟糕的部分。

lines.en: : She’s calling you boring.
lines.zh: : 她是在说你无聊。

lines.en: scene buswarride24
: That’s absolutely not what I’m doing! I seriously didn’t mean anything bad by it!
lines.zh: : 我绝对不是那个意思!我真的没有恶意!

lines.en: : Talking to Karin is like...a nice breeze on a hot summer day! Or a...warm slice of pumpkin pie on a chilly November morning! I just don’t want to accidentally corrupt her!
lines.zh: : 跟 Karin 说话就像……炎热夏日里的一阵清风!或者是……寒冷十一月早晨里一块温热的南瓜派!我只是不想不小心把她带坏!

lines.en: : Soooo...what you’re saying is she’s boring.
lines.zh: : 所以……你的意思是她很无聊。

lines.en: : No! She’s just too pure to get sandwiched between degenerates like us!
lines.zh: : 不是!她只是太纯洁了,不该夹在我们这种变态中间!

lines.en: : I guess I...do come across that way, don’t I?
lines.zh: : 我想我……确实给人那种感觉吧?

lines.en: scene buswarride25
: This isn’t the first time I’m hearing that, of course...A lot of the girls on the softball team have told me the same exact thing.
lines.zh: : 当然,这不是我第一次听人这么说了……垒球队里很多女生都跟我说过一模一样的话。

lines.en: : Karin, why don’t you ever talk about boys?...Karin, what’s your craziest fantasy?...Karin, you’re going to make a great wife one day...
lines.zh: : Karin,你为什么从来不聊男生?……Karin,你最疯狂的幻想是什么?……Karin,你将来一定会是个好妻子……

lines.en: : Pretty sure that last one’s just a compliment, Sis.
lines.zh: : 最后那句应该算是夸奖吧,姐。

lines.en: : And a true one at that. You’re like, total wife material.
lines.zh: : 而且是实话。你简直是百分百的老婆材料。

lines.en: : I just...don’t really understand why it’s so easy for some people to openly talk about things like that.
lines.zh: : 我只是……不太明白为什么有些人能那么坦然地公开聊这种事。

lines.en: : It’s not like I’m...{i}unaware{/i} of the “crappier parts of life” or...that I don’t think about the same sorts of things other people think about.
lines.zh: : 我又不是……{i}不知道{/i}生活里那些『糟糕的部分』,也不是……不会想别人会想的那些事情。

lines.en: : Those are just thoughts I think are better kept to myself because that’s what makes them special.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得那些想法还是留给自己比较好,正因为这样它们才特别。

lines.en: scene buswarride26
: Ugh. Even your explanation about not being pure is too pure.
lines.zh: : 呃。连你解释自己不纯洁的方式都太纯洁了。

lines.en: : I’m okay with you tagging along for the Dorm Wars and whatnot, but if you’re going to keep that up all weekend, just don’t even bother.
lines.zh: : 宿舍大战之类的你跟着来我没意见,但如果你要整个周末都这样,那就别来了。

lines.en: : Uhh...well...what should I do to...look more like someone you’d want to hang out with? Because I can find a way to fit in with most groups, but...with you two, I’m...
lines.zh: : 呃……那……我该怎么做才能……看起来更像你们想一起玩的人?因为我跟大多数圈子都能混进去,可是……跟你们两个,我就……

lines.en: scene buswarride27
: Just go suck a dick or something please. For all of our sakes.
lines.zh: : 去含个鸡巴什么的吧,拜托。为了我们大家好。

lines.en: : A...what?! Why would...anyone ever...
lines.zh: : 什么?!为什么会有人……

lines.en: : Karin, you don’t need to do anything to fit in better with us. I think Kirin is just worried about making you uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : Karin,你不需要为了跟我们合得来而做任何事。我觉得 Kirin 只是怕让你不舒服。

lines.en: : Sure, yeah. Let’s go with that.
lines.zh: : 对,行吧。就这么说吧。

lines.en: scene buswarride28
: Noriko, you’re...not like Kirin too, are you? You know, like...saying such vulgar things all the time and...doing inappropriate stuff just to get a rise out of people?
lines.zh: : Noriko,你……也不像 Kirin 吧?就是那种……满嘴脏话、还为了挑逗别人去做不适当的事?

lines.en: : Me? I mean...maybe a little. But all things considered, I’m probably one of the most wholesome girls in the class.
lines.zh: : 我?嗯……也许有一点。不过综合考虑,我大概算是班上最纯良的女生之一了。

lines.en: : That’s a relief. Because Kirin’s been making it sound like everyone-
lines.zh: : 那我就放心了。因为 Kirin 说得像所有人-

lines.en: : Noriko, why not tell Karin about the time you went over to your {i}boyfriend’s{/i} house and had him finger your brains out on the bed?
lines.zh: : Noriko,要不你给 Karin 讲讲那次你去{i}男朋友{/i}家,让他在床上把你脑子都抠出来的事?

lines.en: scene buswarride29
: Come on, Kirin. In front of Grandma? Really?
lines.zh: : 别这样,Kirin。当着奶奶的面?真的吗?

lines.en: : You...
: Joke?...
: Joke...Yes? Joke?
lines.zh: : 玩笑……对吧?玩笑?

lines.en: scene buswarride30
: Boy, I’m sure excited to go to the beach.
lines.zh: : 天哪,我可真期待去海滩。

lines.en: : And I’m sure excited for Karin to suck her first dick fifty years from now so she can stop being so boring all the time.
lines.zh: : 而我也真期待 Karin 在五十年后含上她的第一根鸡巴,这样她就能别再整天那么无聊了。

lines.en: scene black
: Joke?...
scene buswarride31
: What a lovely day. So bright...and sunny...it’s perfect for a fun competition like the Dorm Wars...isn’t that right, Touka?
lines.zh: : 多好的一天啊。这么明媚……又晴朗……正适合宿舍大战这样有趣的比赛……对吧,Touka?

lines.en: scene buswarride32
: Touka?
lines.zh: : Touka?

lines.en: : Huh? What?
lines.zh: : 嗯?什么?

lines.en: : I apologize. Did you say something, Yasu? I wasn’t paying attention.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。你说了什么吗,Yasu?我刚才没注意听。

lines.en: : Just that it’s a nice day for a competition...Are you excited to go to the beach?
lines.zh: : 只是说今天很适合比赛……你期待去海滩吗?

lines.en: scene buswarride33

: Yes...It’ll be a nice break from school-life. And I’d be lying if I said I haven’t been getting exhausted lately. What with all the bouncing around between the dorms, the manor, and my new apartment complex.
lines.zh: : 期待……能暂时从学校生活里喘口气挺好的。而且说实话,我最近确实累坏了。宿舍、宅邸,还有我新买的公寓楼,来回折腾个不停。

lines.en: : Will you show me your new complex soon? I’m very excited to see it.
lines.zh: : 你很快会带我去看你的新公寓吗?我特别期待。

lines.en: : Of course. I just need to put the finishing touches on your room first.
lines.zh: : 当然。我只是得先把你的房间收尾做好。

lines.en: : Is it really okay for me to live there?
lines.zh: : 我真的可以住在那儿吗?

lines.en: : Of course, Yasu. It’ll help me keep a closer eye on you so that nothing bad will happen.
lines.zh: : 当然可以,Yasu。这样我就能更近地照看你,不会有什么坏事发生。

lines.en: : So you’ll protect me from the fraying of the rope and roots made of wire?
lines.zh: : 所以你会保护我,免受那根磨损的绳子和铁丝做的根的伤害?

lines.en: : ...Yes. That is exactly what I was referring to.
lines.zh: : ……是的。我指的正是那个。

lines.en: scene buswarride34
: Heheh! I’m so glad someone as nice and wonderful as you spends so much time with an insignificant whelp like me.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿!我真高兴有你这么好、这么棒的人,肯花这么多时间陪在我这种无足轻重的小崽子身边。

lines.en: : Stop putting yourself down so much, Yasu. You’ve overcome more in just a few years than most people do in their entire lives.
lines.zh: : 别再那么贬低自己了,Yasu。你在短短几年里克服的东西,比大多数人一辈子克服的都多。

lines.en: : Life is full of obstacles! And if you’re not careful, you’ll fall into an endless pit of despair! But all of those obstacles are only there to test us. And we’ll be stronger than ever once we pass them all.
lines.zh: : 人生充满了障碍!要是不小心,你就会掉进绝望的无底洞!但那些障碍都只是为了考验我们。等我们全部跨过去,就会比以往任何时候都更强。

lines.en: scene black
: I sure hope you’re right about that...
lines.zh: : 我真希望你说得对……

lines.en: scene buswarride35
: You can’t avoid her forever, Ayane. She’s going to catch on.
lines.zh: : 你不可能永远躲着她,Ayane。她早晚会察觉的。

lines.en: : Yeah. Sorry, Maya. Let me just forget all of the terrifying shit you told me at the shrine and set up another slumber party. I see no way that can possibly go wrong with only {i}one{/i} serial killer in attendance.
lines.zh: : 是啊。抱歉,Maya。让我干脆忘掉你在神社跟我说的那些可怕的事,再去办一次睡衣派对。反正只有{i}一个{/i}连环杀手到场,我看不出这能出什么岔子。

lines.en: scene buswarride36
: {i}Shh.{/i} We’re still on a bus, you know. This isn’t exactly the place to be discussing things like that.
lines.zh: : {i}嘘。{/i}我们还在巴士上呢,你知道吧。这种事可不适合在这儿讨论。

lines.en: : Why not? Everybody’s either going to just die or forget it, right? Or was it both? Because I honestly can’t remember.
lines.zh: : 为什么不适合?反正大家不是会死就是会忘掉,对吧?还是两者都有?因为说实话我记不清了。

lines.en: scene buswarride37
: See, this is exactly why I didn’t want to tell you anything.
lines.zh: : 瞧,这正是我不想告诉你任何事的原因。

lines.en: : All you knowing about this does is further complicate things while severing one of the very few ties Ami genuinely {i}cares{/i} about.
lines.zh: : 你知道这些,只会让事情更复杂,同时斩断 Ami 真正{i}看重{/i}的为数不多的几根羁绊之一。

lines.en: : You said there was no one in class you haven’t seen something happen to. And I’m part of that class, right?
lines.zh: : 你说过,班里没有一个人是你没看到过发生在她身上的事的。而我也在那个班里,对吧?

lines.en: : Would she really do something that horrible to me if she {i}cared{/i} about me? Who’s to say she’s not just faking it?
lines.zh: : 如果她真的{i}在乎{/i}我,她真会对我做出那么可怕的事吗?谁说她不是在装而已?

lines.en: scene buswarride38
: You don’t get it, Ayane. She’s deeply traumatized and codependent. And as someone who loves him as much as you claim to, I wouldn’t put it past you to do the same exact thing if you had to.
lines.zh: : 你不懂,Ayane。她受了很深的创伤,而且有情感依赖。作为一个像你声称的那样爱他的人,我不认为换作是你,在不得不那么做的时候会手下留情。

lines.en: : What is it that would make me “have” to, though? What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 可是什么会让我『不得不』呢?那到底是什么意思?

lines.en: : Anything and everything so long as it ensures he’ll remain by your side.
lines.zh: : 任何事、一切事,只要能确保他留在你身边。

lines.en: : Are you saying you’d kill someone to keep Sensei as well?
lines.zh: : 你是说,你也会为了留住 Sensei 而杀人?

lines.en: scene buswarride39
: If I had to? Absolutely.
lines.zh: : 如果不得不?绝对会。

lines.en: : {i}Have{/i} you had to?
lines.zh: : 你{i}曾经{/i}不得不过吗?

lines.en: : You’ve been around a long time, right?
lines.zh: : 你存在很久了,对吧?

lines.en: : It wouldn’t be surprising if something like that happened at least once.
lines.zh: : 如果发生过一次这种事,也不奇怪。

lines.en: : I’ve already told you more than I should have. Learning anything else will just make this even harder for you.
lines.zh: : 我已经告诉你太多了。再知道别的,只会让你更难受。

lines.en: : Yeah, at this point, I’m not sure things can get any harder. I feel like I’ve been caught in a perpetual panic attack ever since leaving the shrine.
lines.zh: : 是啊,事到如今,我不确定还能更难受到哪里去。离开神社之后,我感觉自己一直陷在一场没完没了的惊恐发作里。

lines.en: scene buswarride40
: Ayane...
lines.zh: : Ayane……

lines.en: : What, Maya?
lines.zh: : 怎么,Maya?

lines.en: scene buswarride41
: Ugh...
: I can’t believe I’m saying this, but...
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信自己会这么说,可是……

lines.en: : Would you...like...
lines.zh: : 你……想不想……

lines.en: : Do you...
lines.zh: : 你要不要……

lines.en: : Want...a {i}hug?{/i}
lines.zh: : 来个……{i}拥抱{/i}?

lines.en: scene buswarride42
: Like...
lines.zh: : 就是……

lines.en: : Like...from {i}you?{/i}
lines.zh: : 就是……{i}你{/i}给的?

lines.en: : Is that not what friends are supposed to do in times like this?
lines.zh: : 这种时候朋友不就是该这么做的吗?

lines.en: : I think it’s normally a little more organic.
lines.zh: : 我觉得正常情况下应该更自然一点。

lines.en: : Forgive me for being short on experience. I’m not a very “touchy” person.
lines.zh: : 原谅我经验不足。我不是个喜欢『肢体接触』的人。

lines.en: : Yeah, this is weird.
lines.zh: : 是啊,这很怪。

lines.en: : Very weird.
lines.zh: : 非常怪。

lines.en: : Just forget I even asked.
lines.zh: : 你就当我没问过吧。

lines.en: scene buswarride43
: Sure...yeah.
lines.zh: : 好……行吧。

lines.en: : Hearing that helped, though.
lines.zh: : 不过听了这话,我心里好受些了。

lines.en: : I might take you up on it later.
lines.zh: : 我可能改天再找你兑现。

lines.en: scene black
: Please don’t be in any rush...
lines.zh: : 请千万别着急……
